name: Darfur, Sudan
summary: Ongoing conflict between rival military factions has displaced millions and created severe humanitarian needs across the Darfur region.

name: Gaza
summary: Sustained military operations and blockade conditions have created acute shortages of food, water, medicine, and shelter for the civilian population.

name: Donetsk, Ukraine
summary: Active frontline operations continue to displace residents and damage critical infrastructure across eastern Ukraine.

name: North Kivu, DRC
summary: Armed group activity has driven mass displacement and disrupted access to food and medical care in eastern DRC.

name: Rakhine, Myanmar
summary: Ongoing conflict and movement restrictions continue to severely impact Rohingya and other communities in Rakhine State.

name: Port-au-Prince, Haiti
summary: Gang violence has displaced hundreds of thousands and severely restricted humanitarian access in the capital region.

name: Yemen
summary: Years of conflict and economic collapse have left a majority of the population in need of humanitarian assistance, with food insecurity at crisis levels.

name: Afghanistan
summary: Drought, economic collapse, and large-scale returns from neighboring countries have created widespread humanitarian needs across the country.
